name: Item scaling: a level-scaled creature drops its green items lifted to the level it is shown at
contract: Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1, DestinyWeaver.LevelScaling=1, DestinyWeaver.Scaling.Offset=3 and CoA.ItemScaling=1. The Rake 5807 is a level 10 creature that drops Lionfur Armor 17922 at 100%, authored at item level 10 and required level 5 with 108 armor, which this realm places at item level 8 and required level 4. A level 30 character with open-world scaling on fights it at level 27, 17 levels above its own, and item lifts round down to five-level steps, so the armor it drops is a copy lifted by 15 levels. That lift is measured from the creature, so only the item it is added to moved: item level 23, required level 19, and more armor than the authored 108. With scaling off the same creature is fought at 10 and drops the item itself. Client rendering of the copy is not tested.

steps.label: Scaling on shows The Rake at 27
The scaled corpse holds a copy of Lionfur Armor
The copy is lifted to item level 23, fifteen above the eight this realm gives the armor
The copy carries more armor than the authored 108
The looted copy keeps item level 23
The looted copy requires level 19, fifteen above the four this realm asks for the armor
Scaling off shows The Rake at 10
The unscaled corpse holds the Lionfur Armor itself
The unlifted item keeps the item level this realm gives it, 8
